pace.note: Thresholds are provisional until enough real runs are recorded. pace = remainingFraction / remainingTimeFraction, worst window per host.
pace.reset_soon_note: A window that resets within this many minutes is not paced (remaining / tiny remaining time explodes); it only has to cover expected_cost for its kind, otherwise the plan asks.

claude.model_note: Current Opus id (claude --help accepts full model names; init event reported claude-opus-5-5 on 2026-11-26). Change it here only.

codex.expected_cost_note: Provisional. Measured: the 24-file runner review r1 (2026-11-26) used 0.01 of codex:primary (0.55 -> 0.54); the r2 re-review (43 prior ids) used 0.02 (0.47 -> 0.45).
codex.allow_code_execution_note: Model-run commands always run under the self-tested OS sandbox profile (reads: :minimal platform set, snapshot, codex package dir, node package dir; no writes; no network), so a program cannot read outside those roots. true also grants the node package dir; false omits it (unless codex itself is a node script). Code execution seen in the transcript is an evidence warning either way, never an incomplete reason.
codex.os_sandbox_note: The only mode: model-run commands run under the runner-generated Seatbelt permission profile, self-tested with the same config flags before each run; without macOS Seatbelt, or when the self-test fails, the run is incomplete (no_os_sandbox / os_sandbox_not_enforced) and codex exec never starts. There is no audit-only fallback.

antigravity.rereview_note: Speed knob for a layout with groups (par_layout): a re-review (prior findings given) whose diff is at most rereview_single_group_max_diff_bytes runs one group with every dimension per file chunk instead of one turn per dimension group. plan --prior estimates the same way. No effect with groups [] (already one group).
antigravity.budget_note: Total run budget = per_turn_budget_sec x planned turns, at least min_total_sec (default turn_timeout_sec), capped by max_total_sec (timeout_sec applies only when per_turn_budget_sec is absent). Runtime 1.5.18 (2026-11-27): a one-turn review of the full PR #26 (24 files, 215 KB) took 495 s, so one turn gets min_total_sec 1200 and turn_timeout_sec 1200.
antigravity.max_prompt_text_bytes_note: Upper bound (UTF-8 bytes) for each prompt text block the runner sends. Measured (2026-11-27, runtime 1.5.18): a re-review whose first text block was larger saw it cut at 134,525 bytes, which dropped the earlier findings and dispositions. Over the bound only the checklist is truncated (marked, full copy in the snapshot); when rules, brief, earlier findings and dispositions alone exceed it, the run is incomplete (prompt_over_budget). Claude and Codex have no measured limit and leave it unset.
antigravity.turn_split_note: Runtime 1.5 ("cli"): ONE turn reviews every dimension (groups []); the scope is split into file chunks only above max_files_per_turn / max_bytes_per_turn. Measured on 1.5.18 (2026-11-27): no first-byte wall (longest silent gap 20 s, a single 495 s turn succeeded), and one turn was faster and used about 3.5x fewer tokens than the 6-turn split (516K vs 1835K). The <= 1.4 "par" runtime keeps the old split (par_layout): its local proxy aborts a model call whose first byte takes > 300 s.

par_layout.note: Runtime <= 1.4 (agy_acp_server.par with the local proxy, 300 s first-byte wall; r9 measured a 295 s silent gap): one turn per dimension group, 8-file / 120 KB chunks. Applied over the values above only for that layout.

antigravity.expected_cost_note: Provisional. Measured: one full view_file review used about 0.01 of the Gemini weekly window (r5/r6, 2026-11-25); the 24-file runner review r1 (2026-11-26) used 0.032 of gemini_5h (0.9269 -> 0.8945) and 0.006 of gemini_weekly; the r2 re-review used 0.028 of gemini_5h (0.8881 -> 0.86) and 0.013 of gemini_weekly (0.8124 -> 0.7996). session = 5 h window.
